_about: Premises, smallest to largest. traffic = base customers a day. boh/foh = staff limits. week = how busy each weekday is (Monday first) unless a pitch says otherwise. The van chooses a pitch each morning.

venues.name: Pop-up Pizza Van
venues.desc: A second-hand van with a serving hatch and a small electric oven. Just you, a cool box and a queue. It can pitch up somewhere different every day.

pitches.name: Business park
pitches.desc: Office workers at lunch. Dead at the weekend.

pitches.name: Weekend farmers' market
pitches.desc: Big crowds, Saturday and Sunday only. A pricey pitch.

pitches.name: Brewery taproom yard
pitches.desc: Thursday to Sunday. Beer drinkers tip well.

pitches.name: Seafront car park
pitches.desc: Packed in summer, empty in winter.

venues.name: Food Market Kiosk
venues.desc: A permanent unit in the covered market. Mains power, more footfall, room for a deck oven.

venues.name: Takeaway Shop
venues.desc: Your own shopfront with a proper kitchen, a counter, a few window seats and delivery.

venues.name: Neighbourhood Pizzeria
venues.desc: A sit-down pizzeria. Wood-fired oven, table service, a drinks licence.

venues.name: High Street Restaurant
venues.desc: A big dining room on the high street with a full brigade and a bar.

venues.name: Flagship Trattoria
venues.desc: The destination restaurant. Twin ovens, open kitchen, queues round the block.
